description: The 1981 original, and the earliest de novo peptide sequencing program in this catalog: a computer program that estimates the possible amino acid sequences of a peptide from its mass spectrum, with no database to search. It could also read a sequence from the PTH amino acids released by Edman degradation, which is what sequencing looked like before tandem MS.
The 1983 revision of PAAS, by the same Osaka group with Wollnik added. Sits between the 1981 original and PAAS 3, so the lineage spans three papers in four years.

1984 FORTRAN program that determines the probable amino acid sequence of a peptide from the sequence ion peaks of its mass spectrum, without a database. The third of the Osaka group's lineage, after PAAS (1981) and Improved PAAS (1983), and the most cited of the three.
Computer program for interpreting high-energy collision tandem mass spectra of peptides.

1990 graph-theory algorithm that sequences polypeptides from FAB tandem mass spectra by scoring mass differences, without needing the amino acid composition, and proposes amino acid pairs or triples to bridge missing peaks. Sub-quadratic in the number of residues.
Error-tolerant peptide identification using short de novo sequence tags and flanking masses.

Uses 10 ppm parent-mass accuracy plus immonium-ion composition to replace the database with the set of sequence permutations the mass allows, then feeds the resulting de novo sequences into a similarity search. An early statement of the hybrid de novo plus homology strategy.

Charge-derivatizes a proteolytic digest before MALDI post-source decay so the fragment series reads cleanly, evaluated on a phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase of known structure and then used to sequence an unknown variant from Anaerobiospirillum succiniciproducens.

Isotopic N-terminal labeling with a fragmentation-directing moiety for protein quantitation and facilitated de novo sequencing.
Program that converts high-resolution ECD and CAD fragment masses of intact protein ions into the most probable protein sequence, using ECD to tell N- from C-terminal fragments.

Interactive de novo peptide sequencing application in BioLynx, the biopolymer analysis component of the MassLynx suite. The manual is explicit that it is user-driven rather than automatic: PepSeq "has been designed as an interactive program that allows the user to make decisions at each step in deducing the sequence of a peptide". It scores and annotates spectra on the a, b, y and z ions, and takes input either from a MassLynx data file or as a plain mass and intensity list. Three modes: typing a candidate sequence to see its theoretical fragments annotated against the spectrum; FindTag, which builds a set of sub-sequences whose series ions best match the spectrum and extends them step or leap-wise until the molecular weight matches the user-supplied precursor; and MassSeq, a separately purchased option that performs the sequencing automatically from the precursor mass, modifications and a mass-accuracy estimate. There is no methods paper: the method is documented only in the vendor manual, which is catalogued here as the accompanying resource. Provenance runs Micromass UK Ltd to Waters Corporation, and the Version 4.0 guide catches the handover in progress, carrying a Waters part number and a Micromass part number side by side over a 1993-2002 Micromass UK Ltd copyright.

Bovine mitochondrial small subunit ribosomal proteins resolved by two-dimensional PAGE, in-gel tryptic digestion, capillary LC and electrospray MS/MS, with the resulting peptide sequences used as virtual probes to screen the human EST database by tBLASTN and assemble consensus cDNAs in silico. Spectra without an exact match in either the protein or EST databases were sequenced de novo, manually or with PepSeq. Seven proteins are reported in Table I, and the two de novo-derived peptides are the sole identifying evidence for two of them, MRP-S26 and MRP-S14; MRP-S14 is also one of only two proteins in the study with significant prokaryotic homology, to Escherichia coli S14. Five of the seven belong to a new class of ribosomal proteins with no prokaryotic counterpart.
Derivatization workflow for lysine-terminated tryptic peptides to facilitate PSD MALDI de novo sequencing.
Computational approach to de novo peptide sequencing from MALDI-TOF post-source decay spectra, developed as a PhD thesis at MIT.

Resolves the ion-type ambiguity that makes a tandem mass spectrum hard to read by acquiring the same peptide under differing conditions and comparing the scans, so a fragment's series can be assigned rather than inferred. Aimed at organisms whose genomes are not sequenced, where a database is not an option.

Homology search of error-tolerant de novo sequences against a protein database, introduced for charting the proteomes of organisms with unsequenced genomes and later used to validate borderline identifications.
Dynamic-programming formulation over an NC-spectrum graph for de novo peptide sequencing.
Labels peptide carboxyl groups with d0- or d3-methanol so that mixed samples give quantitation and isotope-paired fragment ions that support automated de novo sequencing.
Determined the sequence of an unknown environmental-pollutant-adsorbing protein from Bacillus pumilus PH-01 using de novo MS/MS peptide sequencing on a QTOF together with N-terminal sequencing.

Deduces peptide sequences without a database by cross-correlating an experimental CID spectrum with predicted sequence patterns from y and non-y fragmentation, claimed insensitive to mass tolerance.

Codes amino acids by mass before MALDI TOF/TOF so that incomplete CID of singly and doubly charged precursors still yields assignable series, recovering spectra that would otherwise go unidentified and making the instrument's throughput usable for de novo work.
Computational framework integrating mass tags and dissociation chemistry for de novo peptide sequencing from MS/MS experiments.

Searches several error-tolerant peptide sequence tags at once, so a protein can be identified across species by sequence similarity even when no tag is individually correct. Tolerating errors in the tags is what lets de novo output drive a homology search.
A dynamic programming de novo algorithm that assigns ion types (a, b, y and neutral losses) to peaks and introduces core interpretations to give confidence values to parts of a sequence.

Downstream application of de novo peptide sequencing to an unidentified plant pathogen. The 32-kDa protein specific to high plains disease was sequenced by time-of-flight MS after the agent was isolated in pure culture by vascular puncture inoculation. De novo sequencing of peptides from proteolytic digests of the SDS-PAGE band corrected the public record: the GenBank nucleotide-derived sequence U60141, deposited as the probable N-protein of high plains virus, turned out to be incomplete, and 18 further residues were found at the N terminus. BLAST then returned no significant homology to any protein in the databases, indicating a hitherto unclassified virus group. A clean early demonstration of why de novo matters: the answer was unreachable by database search because the correct sequence was not in any database.
Sulfonates tryptic peptides with 4-sulfophenyl isothiocyanate on C18 microZipTips so MALDI post-source decay spectra show only y ions, which are then read de novo to identify gel spots.

Two-step database-free strategy enabled by FT-ICR mass accuracy: determine the peptide's amino acid COMPOSITION first, then score only the permutations that composition allows, which is a far smaller search space than conventional de novo sequencing explores.
Selective N-terminal sulfonation of tryptic peptides with 4-sulfophenyl isothiocyanate, adapted to online capillary LC-MS/MS so the spectra are dominated by y ions and read de novo.
Reconstructs peptide sequences from tandem spectra with a genetic algorithm, later extended to parallel multi-objective optimisation with Pareto ranking of conflicting scores.

Uses the Probability Profile Method to label b and y peaks from neutral-loss neighbourhoods and chains them into de novo sequence tags.

Assembles overlapping MS/MS spectra of related peptides into contigs before any sequence is called, so a protein is sequenced from the assembly rather than from individual spectra. Tolerates mixtures and unanticipated modifications.

N-sulfonation before MALDI TOF/TOF directs fragmentation into a single dominant series, so a peptide mass fingerprint that does not identify a protein on its own can be followed by a readable de novo spectrum.

Overlays spectra of 15N-labeled and unlabeled peptides so each ion carries its nitrogen count, adding discriminating power for identification and de novo interpretation.

Sequences a complete novel protein by de novo sequencing its peptides and then assembling them against a HOMOLOGOUS database rather than an exact one, reaching near-full coverage and accuracy where neither approach alone would.
De novo sequencing algorithm combining complementary CID and ETD tandem MS spectra.
Thermolysin-derived collagen IV fragments that stimulate insect immunity in Galleria mellonella were identified by nanoLC-FTICR MS and de novo sequencing, 38 in all.
Methods in Molecular Biology chapter describing de novo sequencing of peptides by mass spectrometry and the concepts behind the main algorithms.
Identifies known and novel plant viruses from coat protein MS/MS spectra by virus database matching and de novo sequence analysis.

Acetylates tryptic peptides in methanol to raise b-ion intensity in MALDI TOF/TOF spectra, making the sequence ladders easier to read and validate. Applied to proteins of the unsequenced Antarctic bacterium Pseudomonas syringae.
Modifies the N-terminus of short frog tryptophyllin peptides to stop b-ion head-to-tail cyclization and scrambling, giving spectra that can be sequenced de novo by ESI and MALDI MS/MS.

De novo sequencing algorithm written for 157 nm photodissociation spectra, which yield clean x-ion series rather than the mixed b/y ions of CID. Reports per-residue accuracy and distinguishes leucine from isoleucine, which equal-mass residues normally make impossible.
Sequences peptides directly from single resin beads of one-bead-one-compound libraries by MALDI-FTICR tandem MS, using a photocleavable linker so the laser releases and fragments the peptide.
Combines de novo sequencing with search of a translated genome to identify sea urchin neuropeptides, increasing the identification rate by 30%.
Tutorial review (Proteomics 2010) surveying de novo peptide sequencing by MS/MS: fragmentation chemistry, manual interpretation, and the algorithmic landscape pre-deep-learning.
Heuristic de novo sequencing for Lys-N peptides fragmented by ETD, exploiting their long c-ion series.
High-throughput de novo sequencing approach for high-resolution shotgun proteomics spectra.
De novo sequencing by MALDI of two new cyclic theta-defensins purified from hamadryas baboon leukocytes, both active in vitro.
Identifies proteome changes of the black root rot fungus Thielaviopsis basicola grown with plant root extracts, using cross-species similarity search and de novo sequencing.

Profiled snow crab muscle allergens and de novo sequenced the newly recognised 40 kDa allergen, arginine kinase, by MALDI and ESI tandem mass spectrometry; the group also de novo sequenced its tropomyosin.

Determines the primary structure of a 13.6 kDa camelid single heavy chain antibody by MALDI-TOF/TOF top-down analysis, recovering most of the sequence from the intact protein rather than from peptides.
Proteomics of lignocellulose-degrading enzymes secreted by an unsequenced white-rot fungus, annotating 665 and 365 de novo peptides by MS BLAST homology search.

An open-source application that merges and validates search-engine results and automatically exploits de novo sequences from unassigned MS/MS spectra, with MS-BLAST searches, for organisms without sequenced genomes.
First HCD-focused de novo
Downstream application combining de novo peptide sequencing algorithms with RACE-PCR to identify a Plasmopara halstedii elicitor protein.
Reconstructs full target protein sequences, including mutations, from MS/MS spectra by using a homologous protein as a template where the database is imperfect.
Proteins changing during embryonic development of the apple snail Pomacea canaliculata were identified by de novo sequencing and MS-BLAST cross-species search.
Characterises root plasma membrane aquaporins of Brassica oleracea by LC-MS/MS, using de novo sequencing to resolve post-translational modifications and to tell isoforms apart.
2-DE MALDI-TOF proteomics of cardoon stalks identified etiolation-related proteins by de novo sequencing and similarity search.
2-DE MALDI-TOF/TOF proteome of an unsequenced fungus where over half the identified spots relied on de novo sequencing.

Immunoglobulin peptides themselves used as biomarkers of an immune response, rather than the antigens they bind. Rats were immunised with one of two purified antigens and immunoglobulins from pre- and post-immune sera were profiled by nano-LC on an LTQ-Orbitrap with top-5 data-dependent fragmentation, giving 684 peptides differentially present between the treatment groups and cluster separation of the two. Sequences were obtained for 44% of spectral features by combining Mascot database search with de novo sequencing in PEAKS Studio 5.1, merged in Progenesis, which keeps the best-scoring sequence per feature. The authors state the de novo half was essential, because immunoglobulins are poorly represented in sequence databases. The shared peptides found across animals indicate that repertoire development is not fully random but under selection pressure favouring the best-binding sequences.
Sequenced the N- and C-terminal regions of both chains of the ABRF-PSRG 2010 study antibody by MALDI in-source decay top-down de novo sequencing.
Characterises new parvalbumin isoforms, the major fish allergens, by combining bottom-up proteomics, accurate intact mass by FTICR and selected MS/MS ion monitoring, with the sequences read de novo.

Turns de novo sequencing into a search problem by generating a VIRTUAL database per spectrum, enumerating the candidate sequences the precursor mass allows, then scoring them as a database search would. Built for high-resolution LTQ-FT data.
Spengler group characterized a tryptophyllin-like peptide family from the skin secretion of the Middle East tree frog by manual de novo and composition-based sequencing on FTICR-MS.
Rescores de novo peptide candidates using proteome signatures, the amino acid usage patterns compiled across a proteome, so the scoring function can prefer plausible residue combinations.
Dimethyl isotope labeling-assisted workflow for de novo peptide sequencing.
Advanced peptide de novo sequencing framework using a pair of tandem mass spectra.
Three previously undescribed peptides, including a hydroxyproline-containing one, from the Middle East tree frog skin secretion were sequenced by manual de novo and composition-based sequencing.
Review of de novo peptide sequencing algorithm development from tandem mass spectra, published in Chinese in Progress in Biochemistry and Biophysics.
Layered MALDI-TOF/TOF identification of dinoflagellate proteins in which de novo sequences searched with MS-BLAST identified proteins missed by database search.
A thesis method that uses complementary b and y fragment ions to improve de novo sequencing from CID spectra.
2D DIGE separated cell wall proteins of the toxic dinoflagellate Alexandrium catenella were identified by MALDI TOF-TOF de novo sequencing followed by homology search, giving 120 proteins.
Tests detection of specific antibody CDR peptides in serum IgG backgrounds by Orbitrap MS, de novo sequencing half of the detectable adalimumab CDR peptides at attomole levels.

Recovers the sequence of an anti-lymphotoxin-alpha mouse hybridoma antibody whose genetic material was lost after a decade in storage, by template proteogenomic de novo sequencing of the stored ascites, then reverse-engineers the gene.
De novo sequencing of peptides in the parotid secretion of the cane toad Bufo marinus, a highly toxic secretion whose peptide content, unlike amphibian skin, had gone unexamined.
Formulates de novo sequencing as an integer knapsack dynamic program so that ions other than b and y contribute to the score.
Lagrangian-relaxation formulation of de novo peptide sequencing. Frames the problem as a constrained optimization over the spectrum graph and solves it with iterative subgradient ascent.
Constrained de novo sequencing algorithm for peptide families such as conotoxins.
Generates peptide sequence tags from MS/MS spectra by graph search, aiming for fast and accurate tags for identification.
Phosphorylates peptide N-termini so that UPLC-MS/MS spectra show enhanced a1 and b-ion series and separate glutamine from lysine, easing de novo peptide sequencing.
Guanidino and amidino N-terminal derivatization reagents that strengthen b-ion series under low-energy CID for easier de novo sequencing.
Ranks MS/MS spectra by sequence-tag quality to find high-quality unidentified spectra for de novo or cross-link analysis.
Combined 2-DE and DIGE with de novo MS/MS sequencing of derivatized peptides to characterize protein isoforms and possible gene silencing across triploid banana cultivars.
A shotgun membrane proteomics workflow for the poorly sequenced banana, using de novo sequencing for sequence homology search and Cytoscape to remove redundant or wrong assignments.

Peak selection model that quantifies how the presence of a derivative peak depends on its primary ion's intensity, so noise can be discarded before sequencing. Benchmarked on the de novo and sequence-tag performance it enables rather than on peak counts.
Expert Review of Proteomics survey of algorithms for de novo sequencing of peptides from tandem mass spectra.

Connects peptide natural products to their biosynthetic gene clusters by iteratively matching de novo tandem MS sequence tags to genome-derived candidate structures; applied to Streptomyces lantipeptides, lasso peptides and lipopeptides.

Selective C-terminal derivatization, which is hard because C-terminal and side-chain carboxyls behave alike, improved in efficiency and given a bromine signature so the C-terminal fragment can be picked out and sequenced.
De-novo-assisted DB search
Screens 26 unsequenced actinomycetes for expressed NRPS and PKS enzymes by protein-first proteomics with improved de novo sequencing, linking products to gene clusters.
Combines a Bayesian network with dynamic programming to explore sub-optimal spectrum-graph paths for de novo peptide sequencing.
Combines Lys-N digestion, ETD and CID/ETD cross-validation to de novo sequence thousands of peptides from the unsequenced ostrich proteome.
Molecular & Cellular Proteomics review/tutorial on de novo sequencing and homology searching.

A MALDI signal-enhancing N-terminal derivatization carrying a bromine isotope signature, so the tagged N-terminal peptide is unmistakable in the spectrum. Used to read N-terminal processing such as methionine or signal-peptide removal, and to annotate uncharacterized proteins.
Multi-enzyme digestion and de novo sequencing determined 98% of the 313-residue sequence of a mannose-binding lectin from alligator serum.
The primary sequence of a monoclonal antibody against alpha-synuclein was determined de novo by mass spectrometry combining ion-trap CID and HCD fragmentation.
Integrated LC-FT-MS/MS, de novo sequencing and homology search identifies over a hundred neuropeptides in tree shrew brain, a species without a proteome.

De novo sequences haemoglobin from nine North American species with unsequenced genomes, with automated processing and manual validation, to build a database that identifies the host a blood meal came from.
Imidazolinylation of Lys-N peptides followed by 193 nm ultraviolet photodissociation, which yields a SINGLE product ion series instead of the overlapping series that defeat most de novo strategies.
Releases one-bead-one-compound hexapeptides through an acid-labile Asp-Pro linker in partly 18O water, so N- and C-terminal ions can be told apart during de novo sequencing.

Proteomic profiles of the brown tide alga under phosphate and nitrogen limitation, with proteins identified by de novo sequencing and cross-species search, including a phosphate-limitation alkaline phosphatase.
De novo markup language: a standard file format plus API for representing and exchanging results from different de novo sequencing tools.
Reviews spectral network algorithms that match spectra against each other, which delivered the longest de novo sequences and cyclic peptide sequencing.
Manual and automated de novo sequencing with CID and ETD data recovered the N-terminal half of a disulfide-bridged Texas coral snake toxin.
Solves the nested forbidden-pairs longest path problem behind spectrum-graph de novo sequencing in cubic time by vertex contraction.
Metaproteomics of a thermophilic biogas community fed agricultural biomass, identifying housekeeping and methanogenesis enzymes through Mascot search plus de novo sequencing.
Ecotoxicoproteomics of zebra mussel gills exposed to triclosan; altered proteins in this poorly sequenced organism were identified by 2-DE and de novo sequencing.

HLA class I peptidomes of four melanoma cell lines, extracted from isolated HLA, separated by two-dimensional HPLC and sequenced by MALDI post-source-decay MS. Spectra were interpreted twice over, by database-dependent Mascot search and by database-independent de novo sequencing in Sequit!, with synthetic peptides used to confirm assignments and to measure immunogenicity. Overlap between the four peptidomes was small, indicating highly individual HLA peptidomes, yet they were broadly immunogenic both in the patients the lines came from and in unrelated patients, and that cross-patient immunogenicity was only exceptionally attributable to individual peptides. Most epitopes came from low to medium abundance proteins in sensitive processes such as cell cycle control, DNA replication and tumour suppression.
Purifies and de novo sequences a novel Bowman-Birk serine protease inhibitor from Lathyrus sativus seeds by electrospray mass spectrometry, a two-headed small protein with distinct reactive loops.
Shotgun protein sequencing with meta-contig assembly for longer de novo protein contigs.

Staged neural network that models ion fragmentation patterns and estimates the posterior probability of each ion type, used to pick the informative peaks out of an MS/MS spectrum before sequencing. The motivation is search-space control: too many peaks and the candidate peptide space grows exponentially, too few and the ion ladder has gaps that can only be explained by permutations of amino acid combinations, so either way candidate quality drops. Reported to beat other preprocessing techniques and to cut the candidate search space substantially without losing candidate quality. The authors note the step matters to any interpretation of MS/MS spectra, de novo or not. Two papers a year apart: the BIBM 2012 classifier, and the two-stage version in Proteome Science 2013 that states it improves on it.

Identifies eight intact antimicrobial peptides from the skin of the frog Odorrana jingdongensis by de novo sequencing of low-energy ESI CID Q-TOF spectra, supported by Edman degradation and similarity analysis.

First high-throughput proteome of mango leaf, an unsequenced plant, combining EST and cross-species database search with de novo sequencing and homology-based identification (1001 peptides, 538 proteins).
Identifies biofilm-induced outer membrane proteins of the marine bacterium Pseudoalteromonas sp. D41 by MS/MS de novo sequencing.
Self-contained tutorial on de novo peptide sequencing from MS/MS: models the problem formally, then reviews the major algorithmic approaches and their post-processing.

High-definition de novo sequencing of crustacean hyperglycemic hormone family neuropeptides, large signalling peptides above 4 kDa whose functions cannot be read without both the sequence and the modifications.
Allergens in the urticating setae of Thaumetopoea pityocampa were characterized, and MALDI-MS de novo sequencing gave a partial sequence of a new major allergen named Tha p 2.

Labels peptide N-termini and lysines with light or heavy phosphoryl groups in a one-pot reaction, improving ionization, strengthening fragment series and giving isotope signatures that ease de novo sequencing and relative quantification.
De novo peptide sequencing algorithm using a neural-network ion classifier, dynamic programming candidate generation, and amino acid usage/edge-frequency scoring.
Manual de novo sequencing combined with a cDNA-derived local database identified 130 toxin-like proteins in a spider venom and found methyl-esterified glutamate.
Protein identification method integrating de novo sequencing with database searching.
Complementary HCD + ETD spectra
Isolates a novel tripeptide from young Azadirachta indica leaves and determines its sequence by de novo MS/MS.
Positive charge derivatization + spectra merging
De novo peptide sequencing of the protein purified from red blood cell membranes identified the long-sought Vel blood group antigen carrier as SMIM1, later confirmed genetically.
Cellular and extracellular proteome map of Brevibacterium linens DSM 20158, an unsequenced strain, built by Mascot homology search extended with de novo sequencing and MS BLAST.

Uses negative- and positive-mode chemically activated fragmentation of derivatized peptides to de novo sequence proteins of Lactobacillus brevis, revealing 36 proteins changed after long-term starvation.
Treats fragmentation sites as a physical system; the ground state yields the de novo peptide and thermodynamic variables estimate confidence.
Isolation of an antitumor and antioxidant polypeptide from the ark clam Arca subcrenata, with partial sequences read by MALDI-TOF/TOF de novo sequencing.
Sequencing-grade de novo analysis from overlapping CID/HCD/ETD MS/MS triplets.
Characterises Tityus serrulatus scorpion venom, including phospho- and glycoproteome, combining database search with de novo sequencing to reveal modified toxins.
A de novo sequencing algorithm that allows many PTM types while bounding the number of modifications per peptide to keep accuracy.

A de novo sequencing script for microbial cyclic peptides that assigns b-ion series over a library of 312 nonribosomal building blocks, shown on beauverolide, roseotoxin A, pseudacyclin A and cyclosporin A.
Universal de novo sequencing tool trained across fragmentation methods and instruments.

Predictor of MS/MS fragment-ion peak intensities, used to rescore search-engine and de novo sequencing results. Introduced in 2013 as a random-forest model; the 2019 web-server update added models for further fragmentation methods, instruments and labelling techniques, and the 2023 update added tryptic, non-tryptic, immunopeptide and TMT models and proteome-wide predicted spectral libraries with DeepLC retention times.
Places methionine in the macrocycle and linker so cyanogen bromide linearises and releases cyclic library peptides, which are then sequenced manually and with de novo software.

N-terminal chromophore derivatisation makes a peptide absorb at 351 nm, so selective UV photodissociation cleaves it into a simplified y-ion series instead of the mixed ladders CID gives, deliberately to make the spectra amenable to de novo sequencing.

A non-targeted differential peptidomic comparison of intestinal epithelial cells with and without LPS stimulation, where high-resolution MS and partial de novo sequencing name the secreted chemokines.
Derivatizes peptide N-termini with 14N- or 15N-labeled 4-amidinobenzoic acid so b-ions show as doublets and improved CID fragmentation simplifies de novo sequencing.
Immune-stimulatory peptides from thermolysin-digested Galleria mellonella hemolymph were identified by high-resolution MS using a transcriptome and de novo sequencing, and six were confirmed active.

Two lysine isotopologues differing by 36 mDa are embedded metabolically, so every C-terminal fragment appears as a resolvable doublet and N-terminal ones do not. An algorithm reads that signature to label y-type ions at 93.2% accuracy, which among other uses lifts correct de novo identifications with PepNovo+ by 34%.
De novo sequencing of HCD spectra with a multi-edge spectrum graph that integrates amino acid combinations, peptide tags and immonium ions.
Isolation of an anti-tumor polypeptide from the clam Arca inflata, with four partial sequences determined by MALDI-TOF/TOF de novo sequencing.
Purifies thermally tolerant pectin methylesterase from orange and uses MALDI-TOF/TOF de novo sequences to match ESTs and clone its gene.

Open-source Java graphical user interface for tandem-MS de novo sequencing. Wraps PepNovo+, DirecTag, Novor, and pNovo behind a single workflow with shared input/output handling and result inspection. From the CompOmics group at Ghent + collaborators in Bergen, Magdeburg, and Salzburg.
De novo sequencing characterised peptides formed abiotically from glutamic acid, including sodium and potassium substitutions, in an origin-of-life model reaction.

Reads amino acid substitutions in the influenza A nucleocapsid protein by mass spectrometry with de novo sequencing, substitutions being the route by which non-synonymous mutations become antigenic shift and changed virulence.
Exploits bounded path width of an extended spectrum graph to compute antisymmetric partial paths for fast de novo sequencing.
SPITC N-terminal derivatization + 18O labeling coupled with de novo peptide sequencing to simultaneously identify and quantify spider-venom peptides from species with unknown genomes.

Shows that b2 ions in HCD spectra can be assigned with over 97% certainty when a2 and the complementary y ion are present, and uses the resulting two-residue N-terminal tags to filter PSMs and deconvolute co-fragmented spectra.
Adds H2 18O and trypsin directly to the digest so 18O is incorporated at peptide C-termini, marking y-ions to ease de novo sequencing without extra drying steps.
PhD work on identifying peptides from MIXTURE tandem mass spectra, where two or more peptides co-fragment: formulates the de novo problem for a mixture spectrum and solves it by dynamic programming.
De novo peptide sequencing for ECD/ETD spectra, using a spectrum graph with multiple edge types for the c- and z-ion variants those spectra carry.

Predictor for Xle Sites: combines leucine aminopeptidase and chymotrypsin selectivity experiments with germline frequencies in a logistic regression that calls Leu or Ile at ambiguous sites in de novo sequenced mAbs, at 96% accuracy.
Uses top-down spectra of the intact protein as a scaffold to assemble bottom-up de novo peptide reads into a full protein sequence.

Separates the isomeric residues leucine and isoleucine during de novo sequencing by instrument rather than by inference: multistage ETD isolates the primary odd-electron z-dot ions and HCD then drives radical-site fragmentation into w-ions, whose masses differ between the two isomers and which come out as the most intense peaks in the spectrum. Demonstrated on six natural non-tryptic peptides of 15 to 37 residues from Rana ridibunda frog skin secretion, resolving all 22 Leu/Ile positions.
Aligns de novo peptide sequences from several tools against a target-decoy database and uses a neural network to report homologous proteins at a controlled FDR.
Discovers single amino-acid variants without SNP databases by pairing de novo sequencing candidates against theoretical proteins, then re-searching to control FDR; applied to human brain tissue.
An optimisation-based de novo sequencing algorithm designed to be robust to missing peaks, noise and modifications.

Makes broad-specificity proteases usable in phosphoproteomics: a conventional database search cannot identify phosphopeptides without enzyme specificity, so de novo sequencing proposes the sequence and the search confirms it.

Extends the authors' spectrum graph model to pairs of CID or HCD and ECD or ETD spectra of the same peptide, using the ion types of both to improve full-length de novo sequencing accuracy over pNovo+.
Structure of a novel cytotoxic cyclic peptide from a South China Sea Brevibacillus strain was proposed from MALDI-TOF/TOF de novo sequencing.
Hybrid tag-based database search that derives amino acid tags as short as one residue and combines tag and pattern-matching scores to rank PSMs.
Compares low-energy CID and HCD for de novo sequencing of natural non-tryptic peptides with disulfide bonds and proline residues.
UV photodissociation de novo
Mass Spectrometry Reviews tutorial/review on lessons in de novo peptide sequencing by tandem mass spectrometry.
Open-source Java GUI that aggregates and inspects search-engine and de-novo-engine results: the third sibling alongside DeNovoGUI and SearchGUI from the CompOmics-aligned Bergen / Ghent group.
Forms light and deuterated methyl esters at the C-terminus or acetamides at the N-terminus so that mass shifts between isotopologues pick out C- and N-terminal ion series for de novo sequencing.
Reduces cyclic peptide sequencing from mass spectra to the beltway problem and solves it with an algorithm that restores sequences of up to 160 residues.
Adds bromine to the free-radical-initiated peptide sequencing reagent so N-terminal fragments carry a doublet signature that eases de novo reading.
De novo peptide sequencing of 2D-gel spots followed by homology-based identification characterises the gila monster venom proteome, 19 of its 39 proteins not reported before in helodermatid venom.
Finds antiproliferative peptides in alcalase hydrolysates of Dendrobium catenatum protein and sequences the most abundant by de novo sequencing.
Purification of an antitumor protein from the blood clam Tegillarca granosa, with six partial amino acid sequences determined by MALDI-TOF/TOF de novo sequencing.
Pairs spectra from Lys-N and Lys-C digests whose sequences are single-residue transposed and solves them together as one de novo problem, with residue-level confidence.
Attacks the low identification rate caused by MIXTURE spectra, where more than one peptide co-fragments, by using de novo interpretation to characterize what the spectrum actually contains.
Isolates five novel antifungal peptides from Leuconostoc mesenteroides DU15 sequenced de novo with PEAKS, active against Aspergillus niger.
Combined SEQUEST with manual de novo sequencing of all unassigned spectra to characterise the proteins and peptides of honeybee drone reproductive glands.
Optimised collision energy for QTOF CID of peptides, assessed PEAKS de novo accuracy by peptide length, and de novo sequenced an unknown disulphide-rich bioactive peptide.
A de novo sequencing framework that combines spectra of the same peptide from complementary fragmentation methods such as CID/HCD with ECD/ETD.
Top-down and bottom-up venomics of Ophiophagus hannah, where de novo sequence tags from intact toxins identified three-finger toxins, a novel PLA2 and other proteins.
Real-time decision-tree scoring
De novo MALDI-TOF/TOF sequencing of skin secretion peptides of the green-tree frog Hypsiboas cinerascens revealed five new hylaseptin-related peptides, cinerascetins, also mapped by MALDI imaging.
Isolates and de novo sequences ToHyp1 and ToHyp2, two homologous proline-hydroxyproline glycopeptides from Taraxacum officinale flowers that resemble no known protein, and tests their activity.

Determined the complete sequences of two new 34-residue calcitonin-like peptides from Chinese frog skin secretion by de novo MS/MS using CID and ETD, differential alkylation and isotope dimethyl labeling.
Review of recent computational methods for de novo peptide sequencing from tandem mass spectrometry.
Open-source de novo identification engine for nonribosomal peptides, reading accurate product ion masses to handle linear, cyclic and branched topologies that ordinary peptide tools cannot express.

Captured cationic antimicrobial peptides from American alligator plasma with functionalized hydrogel microparticles and sequenced them by de novo-assisted ETD tandem MS, identifying 340 peptides and five novel antimicrobials.
Automatic de novo sequencing (PEAKS Studio) with CID/HCD/ETD triplex MS/MS to elucidate the full-length sequence of a new PLA2 K49 (Btt-TX) from Bothriopsis taeniata snake venom.
Screens simulated-digestion cowpea peptides for HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, identifying candidates by de novo MS/MS sequencing.
Enumerates every peptide sequence compatible with the accurate precursor mass and searches them with SEQUEST, turning database search into de novo-like sequencing.

De novo sequencing from TOP-DOWN spectra, where the whole protein is fragmented rather than tryptic peptides: derives sequence tags and assembles them through a T-Bruijn graph, evaluated on carbonic anhydrase 2 and an alemtuzumab Fab.
Mines novel allergens from coconut pollen, a significant respiratory sensitiser in India, by manual de novo sequencing combined with homology-driven proteomics.

Screens Odorrana schmackeri and Bombina variegata skin secretions for sulfur-containing peptides via mass defect and isotopic shift, then de novo sequences the candidates to find novel disulfide-bonded peptides.
De novo bottom-up sequencing of a monoclonal light chain showed that a subset of kappa and lambda germline sequences with CDR insertions explains a higher-mass light-chain phenotype in serum.

A proteomic workflow built on high-throughput de novo sequencing for non-model crop plants, where the genome information needed for a database search is missing and cultivars have to be compared anyway.

Routine de novo sequencing of non-tryptic frog skin peptides on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos with manual spectrum interpretation, on the argument that natural non-tryptic peptides are harder than the tryptic case automation was built for.
Reanalysed the unassigned spectra of a minimal bacterial proteome with de novo sequencing, attributing them to modifications, sequence variants and mistranslation.
Application of de novo sequencing to large-scale complex proteomics data sets.

Combines mass-spectrometry de novo sequencing of antibody variable domains with small phage-displayed libraries and antigen-binding selection to resolve ambiguous CDR residues, recovering functional Fabs for two anti-CD137 antibodies.
Sequences a human astrovirus-neutralizing monoclonal antibody de novo and re-expresses it, addressing the common case where a useful antibody exists as protein but its sequence and cell line do not.
Assembles overlapping de novo sequenced peptides from multiple digests into whole protein sequences such as antibodies.
Fills missing residues in de novo protein scaffolds against a homologous reference to maximise BLOSUM62 score, with exact and greedy algorithms tested on antibodies.
SPITC derivatization of tryptic peptides, done at acidic pH to avoid side reactions, with chemically activated fragmentation on MALDI and the DUST de novo tool tuned to SPITC chemistry.
A software package automating de novo sequencing by matching spectra to a randomized sequence database and transcriptome data for protein identification.
Detected three single amino acid substitutions in neuraminidase of influenza A/PR/8/34 H1N1 by LC-MS/MS with manual de novo sequencing of mutated peptides.
Pinpoints cysteines responsible for aerobic energy quenching in the FMO antenna protein of Chlorobaculum tepidum using de novo sequencing MS, chemical modification and mutagenesis.
Assembles de novo sequenced peptides and their per-residue confidence scores into a de Bruijn graph to reconstruct complete monoclonal antibody heavy and light chains without a template.
De novo peptide sequencing method for mixture tandem mass spectra.
Takes a set of de novo amino acid strings derived from top-down tandem mass spectra and analyses the protein sample from them, rather than matching spectra to a database.
Sequencing of ancient peptides bound to ostrich eggshell mineral surfaces, demonstrating protein survival into deep time (~3.8 million years) via de novo MS/MS workflows.
De novo peptide sequencing using paired CID and HCD spectra.

Book chapter reviewing the de novo peptide sequencing field: its history, manual interpretation, the algorithmic approaches, scoring functions, the available software and its applications. Written by the author of PEAKS.
Spectra library assisted de novo peptide sequencing for paired HCD and ETD spectra.
Book chapter presenting de novo sequencing as the alternative to database search engines in shotgun proteomics, covering its pitfalls and challenges and reviewing the main available tools.
Methods in Molecular Biology protocol for mining high-resolution MS data by de novo peptide sequencing rather than database search.

MS-based peptidomics of the Brazilian tarantula Acanthoscurria gomesiana venom, using de novo analysis plus transcriptome and homology searches to fully sequence mature cysteine-rich toxins and find new antimicrobial peptides.
Uses multistage fragmentation on nanoflow LC to distinguish leucine from isoleucine in mAb peptides online, for de novo antibody sequencing.
De novo MS/MS sequencing workflow for native human antibodies.
Uses Novor de novo sequence tags for approximate matching against protein databases to accelerate database search.
pNovo with thousands of PTMs
Pairs Lys-C and Lys-N digests, whose peptides share mass and retention time but fragment differently, with ultrahigh-resolution FT-ICR MS/MS for de novo amino acid sequencing.
Non-isobaric peptide termini labeling assisted peptide de novo sequencing.

Combines de novo MS/MS sequencing of enriched antibodies and co-extracted proteins with label-free quantification of the new peptides, uncovering a hidden blood proteome useful for patient stratification.

De novo sequencing of top-down tandem mass spectra, aimed at the proteins no database can serve -- organisms with unknown genomes, antibodies, novel splice variants -- and at recovering a complete sequence rather than peptide-length fragments.
Characterises the predominant urinary protein of two mouse lemur species, whose complete 87-residue sequence was determined by de novo sequencing and revealed an Ala/Thr difference between species.

De novo protein sequencing of QBEND/10, a mouse monoclonal against the haematopoietic progenitor antigen CD34, followed by humanization and in vitro testing of the resulting antibody on endothelial tube formation.
Hadoop-distributed implementation of UniNovo for efficient de novo peptide sequencing.

Briefings in Bioinformatics review evaluating whether de novo sequencing has become an accurate alternative to database-driven peptide identification. Surveys state-of-the-art tools and benchmark performance circa 2017.
Bioprospected Komodo dragon plasma for cationic antimicrobial peptides by ETD de novo sequencing matched to an assembled transcriptome, finding 48 candidates, mostly histone-derived.

Automated antibody de novo sequencing: finds the closest-matching germline V-J-C sequences by database search, then converges on the true heavy and light chains by iterative wildcard substitution against the MS/MS spectra. Commercial, shipped in Protein Metrics' Byos platform.

Automated off-line LC MALDI MS/MS of the skin secretion of the Cuyaba dwarf frog Physalaemus nattereri, sequenced de novo in PEAKS and matched by BLAST against amphibian UniProt; most deduced sequences match nothing known.

Scores a candidate sequence by the symmetric difference between the masses it explains and the masses actually measured, penalising an explained mass that was not observed as well as an observed mass left unexplained. Earlier scoring models only maximised the number of explained masses.
De novo sequencing of twelve short single-disulfide conopeptides from four cone snail species, including the shortest contryphan characterised and one with a brominated tryptophan.
Database-independent Protein Sequencing: de novo sequencing plus assembly that determines full-length protein and antibody sequences without a database.
Proteomics of the trunk-disease fungus Lasiodiplodia theobromae, where de novo peptide sequencing alongside database search revealed novel proteins including proteases and allergenic enolases.
Combined acetylation and guanidinylation of peptides gives equivalent b- and y-ion representation in ion-trap MS/MS, allowing accurate de novo annotation.
Combining multiple de novo tools
Compares Novor, PEAKS and PepNovo+ for identifying the 48 proteins of the UPS2 standard, pure and spiked into E. coli and human plasma.
Hybrid ant colony optimisation with local search that reconstructs cyclic peptide sequences from distorted mass spectra.
Multi-protease, multi-dissociation proteomics of brown spider venom, with spectral networks and meta-contig assembly yielding de novo sequences of nearly complete proteins.
The model that started the deep-learning wave (CNN+LSTM)
Separates and identifies iron-chelating peptides from defatted walnut flake by nanoLC-ESI-MS/MS and de novo sequencing.
Book chapter on proteomic de novo sequencing of monoclonal antibodies when the hybridoma or its DNA sequence is unavailable or unreliable.
Completely sequenced a novel male-biased urinary lipocalin of the bank vole from MS/MS by de novo sequencing and homology alignment, resolving Leu/Ile by metabolic labelling.
Toxins (2017) review and database surveying snake venom proteomes assembled largely via de novo sequencing: entry point into venomics as a downstream application area for de novo methods.
A scoring feature from intensity ratios of adjacent y-ions, learned from the NIST library, that improved Novor and X!Tandem.
Detects overlapping peptides, frequent in antibody heavy-chain samples, and uses them through labeling and voting strategies to correct de novo sequencing errors.
Compares sequence coverage of five model proteins from MASCOT and X!Tandem against PEAKS, Novor and PepNovo+ across multiple proteases.

Companion vision paper by the DeepNovo authors laying out how deep learning applies to protein identification end-to-end (from spectrum → amino-acid tokens → peptide → protein). Predates the PNAS DeepNovo paper by a few months.
Designs synthetic peptide libraries so that LC-MS/MS de novo sequencing with automated filtering decodes up to 600 sequences per hour.

Completes the sequences of antimicrobial peptides in Isometrus maculatus scorpion venom by mass spectrometry, where venom-gland transcriptomics had multiplied candidate AMPs without confirming the mature peptides.

Review, in Japanese, of the fundamental and practical aspects of de novo peptide sequencing.
Review of de novo sequencing approaches for peptides and whole proteins, their applications and open problems.

Radical fragmentation by hydrogen atom attachment on a MALDI instrument, which keeps the labile phosphate in place while cleaving the backbone, so tryptic phosphopeptides can be sequenced de novo and their phosphosites located.

Label-free proteomics of the diatom-bearing foraminifer Amphistegina gibbosa and its symbionts under thermal stress, identifying proteins of a poorly sequenced host by de novo sequencing plus homology search.

Asks whether two-dimensional FT-ICR mass spectrometry with infrared-activated electron capture dissociation, correlating precursors and fragments without isolation, improves de novo peptide sequencing.

Examines how mass measurement accuracy and gaps in sequence coverage limit protein de novo sequencing by top-down and middle-down MS/MS.
Constrained de novo sequencing of MHC-I neoepitope peptides, which differ from a reference peptide by a mutation, from immunopeptidomic MS/MS.
De novo sequencing that models the peak intensity distribution in a probabilistic score, relating intensities to cleavage positions to rank candidate peptides.
Identifies cowpea peptides that cross intestinal cell monolayers by de novo sequencing and tests synthetic analogues on cholesterol-related gene expression.
Purifies a novel apyrase from Daboia russelii venom whose identity rested on de novo sequences carrying apyrase domains.
Determined the translation of the CUG codon in budding yeast species from de novo peptide sequences and proteome database matching, revealing three parallel genetic code changes.

Open-source common interface wrapping a wide set of proteomics database search engines (X!Tandem, MS-GF+, Comet, OMSSA, MS Amanda, MyriMatch, Tide, Andromeda, MetaMorpheus, Sage) plus classical de novo engines (PepNovo+, DirecTag, Novor, pNovo). Peptidomics workflow using nano-LC-MS/MS and PEAKS de novo sequencing against a transcriptome-derived database to characterise <10 kDa bioactive peptides from Bufo gargarizans (Venenum Bufonis) skin secretions.
Uses genetic programming to classify MS/MS peaks as signal or noise before de novo sequencing, improving PEAKS identification over intensity thresholding.
Purified R-phycocyanin and R-phycoerythrin from a red alga and derived near-complete subunit sequences from MS data using de novo tools, homology search and manual validation.
Venomics workflow combining SDS-PAGE + LC-MS/MS with Novor + PEAKS de novo sequencing and MS-BLAST similarity search to characterize the venom proteome of the hump-nosed pit viper (Western Ghats).
Purification and characterization of a serine protease from tamarillo fruit, identified as subtilisin-like from de novo sequenced peptides.

Extends the symmetric difference scoring model with the chromatographic retention time, asking for a sequence consistent with both the fragment spectrum and the observed elution time. Develops an algorithm for each of three retention-time prediction models.
Muth, Hartkopf, Vaudel & Renard 2018 review essay in Proteomics: state of the current de novo sequencing tool landscape, recent applied use cases, and outlook on where the field is heading.
Thirteen de novo sequenced peptides assembled the full sequence of the olive pollen allergen Ole e 7, which was then cloned and shown to retain allergenicity.
Studies carbamylation and dual modification of peptides to enrich b- and y-ion series, including b1, for easier de novo sequencing by Q-TOF.
FDR-controlled ensembling

Venomics of the ant Tetramorium bicarinatum in which venom peptides were sequenced by de novo MS (PEAKS) or Edman and combined with transcriptomics to define 37 myrmicitoxin precursors in three superfamilies.
De novo sequencing of a 1177 Da Fc impurity revealed an unexpected splicing-derived extension, fixed by changing the glycine codon.
Runs successive Edman steps on a tryptic digest and de novo sequences each stage by MS to fix the N-terminal residues of peptides.

Cyclopeptide sequencing
Rat cecum metaproteomics in which PEAKS de novo peptides gave the taxonomic profile through Unipept and seeded the custom search database.
Combined Edman degradation and de novo peptide sequencing to isolate and characterize U-MYRTX-MRArub1, a novel insecticidal decapeptide from Myrmica rubra ant venom.
Chemical modification-assisted de novo sequencing of antimicrobial peptides in scorpion venom.
Genetic-algorithm approach for de novo peptide sequencing from tandem mass spectra.
Decodes an E. coli-expressed protein whose sequence spells two English sentences, by bottom-up proteomics, de novo sequencing and a dictionary search.
De novo sequencing of synthetic peptides from the YPIC-EuPA challenge revealed a quotation from J.J. Thomson, later confirmed by database search.
De novo sequencing of 19 synthetic peptides from the first YPIC challenge recovered the hidden English sentence, later refined with a database approach.
Decoded synthetic peptides encoding an English text by MaxQuant de novo sequencing, then identified the source book by web search and confirmed it by database search.

De novo sequencing of alcalase hydrolysate fractions of pajuro protein identified 30 novel peptides, ten of which were synthesised and shown to scavenge radicals.

De novo sequencing from mirror spectrum pairs: digesting the same sample with Ac-LysargiNase and with trypsin yields two spectra whose b and y ion series complement each other, which pins down the sequence far more confidently than either alone.
Matches de novo sequence tags against a proteome with an unrestricted string-based search and a probabilistic model, identifying thousands of modification types across large datasets.

Immunopeptidome neoantigen discovery

Genetic-programming-derived scoring function for re-ranking peptide-spectrum matches emitted by de novo sequencing tools. Improves top-k accuracy over the default scorer.
Multi-Enzymatic Limited Digestion uses a diluted, time-limited mix of proteases to produce overlapping peptides, with a custom assembly algorithm that turns them into de novo protein sequences.
Sequence-Mask-Search seq2seq
Crystal structures of Pteropus alecto MHC I plus de novo LC-MS/MS of peptides eluted from a random library exchange show a bat-specific three-residue insertion promotes high-affinity peptide binding.
Genetic programming classifiers that separate b/y-ion peaks from noise before identification, raising PEAKS de novo identification rates on noisy CID spectra.

Parallelises a PepNovo-style scoring search across the Sunway many-core architecture, using a two-level task partition and a load-balancing scheme to keep the compute elements busy. Learning-to-rank + pDeep

Proteins of the Asian common toad parotoid macrogland secretion were identified by database search and de novo analysis, the latter yielding 153 peptides.
Palaeoproteomic enamel-protein workflow on a 1.77-million-year-old Stephanorhinus tooth from Dmanisi, resolving rhinoceros phylogeny beyond the reach of ancient DNA.
De novo peptide sequencing showing structural variants of the gyroxin toxin in the venom of the rattlesnake Crotalus durissus terrificus.
Proteome-based de novo sequencing of novel conotoxins from the molluscivorous cone snail Conus amadis, with the neurological activity of the natural venom assayed in zebrafish.
PepSAVI-MS discovered the novel proline-rich antimicrobial peptide Atr-AMP1, whose sequence was determined by EThcD-enabled de novo sequencing with multistage HCD to tell leucine from isoleucine.
Combines proteogenomics with peptide de novo sequencing to refine the genome annotation of the fungus Sordaria macrospora, finding new genes and hidden post-transcriptional modifications.
Spectral clustering and de novo identification decoded the unknown synthetic protein of the 2018 YPIC challenge and characterized its PTMs.
Palaeoproteomic de novo workflow that recovered the enamel proteome of a 1.9-million-year-old Gigantopithecus blacki molar from Chuifeng Cave, placing it as an early-diverging pongine.
Combines database search and de novo sequencing on DIA immunopeptidomics data, so HLA peptides can be identified without a DDA-built spectral library.
De novo peptide sequencing of edible bird's nest extracts studied for their neurotrophic properties.
Identified a male-biased urinary lipocalin, arvicolin, in the unsequenced water vole Arvicola terrestris through de novo sequencing and homology searches.
Venom peptidome of the plant-ant Tetraponera aethiops from transcriptomics plus PEAKS de novo sequencing (ALC above 60%), characterising nine mature pseudomyrmecitoxin sequences, some dimeric.
Isolated canine hepcidin from greyhound serum and determined its sequence by manual de novo sequencing, correcting earlier conflicting reports of its size.
Uses automated de novo sequencing to test whether a set of spectra holds peptide spectra at all and whether a protein database suits it, for unsequenced species, metaproteomes and extinct organisms.
Selects 23 virgin olive oil peptides from Orbitrap MS/MS with de novo sequencing and shows ACE inhibition in vitro and antihypertensive effects in rats.

Venomics workflow combining SDS-PAGE and ion-exchange pre-fractionation with LC-MS/MS + Novor and PEAKS de novo sequencing to identify 97 proteins (including 18 exclusive to de novo) from Trimeresurus malabaricus venom, and evaluate antivenom cross-reactivity.
Compares alcalase against trypsin for releasing antioxidative peptides from Atlantic sea cucumber, sequencing the active peptides de novo by LC-MS/MS and docking them to predict in vivo function.

Database-independent de novo sequencing from paired Lys-C and Lys-N digests, whose single-residue-transposed peptides yield complementary high-resolution spectra, with residue-level confidence reported per call.

Extended top-down venomics workflow using in-source decay (ISD) with 1,5-diaminonaphthalene reducing matrix to enable disulfide-bond counting and de novo sequencing-based identification of high-molecular-weight venom constituents, applied to the newly described Vipera anatolica senliki.
Analyses GM-CSF autoantibodies from an autoimmune alveolar proteinosis patient by TIMS-TOF proteogenomics, confirming CDR3 to FR4 peptides by de novo sequencing.
Palaeoproteomic de novo + tag-search workflow that recovers enamel proteome from a ~800,000-year-old Homo antecessor tooth and uses the resulting sequences to place the lineage on the hominin tree.
Venom peptidome of the red ant Manica rubida by transcriptomics plus PEAKS de novo peptide sequencing, identifying 13 myrmicitoxins, six of them insecticidal.

GPU-based parallel factor analysis that deconvolves DIA scans into individual analyte spectra; the deconvolved spectra give more high-confidence de novo sequences with DeepNovo and Novor than DIA-Umpire output.
Proteogenomics and de novo sequencing of the immunopeptidomes of patient colorectal cancer liver metastases to find HLA peptides that database search misses.
Finds ACE- and DPP4-inhibitory, antioxidant and metal-chelating peptides in greater weever myofibrillar hydrolysates, sequenced de novo.

Identifies and de novo sequences single-disulfide conopeptides from Conus zonatus and Conus caracteristicus venom using MSn of native and derivatized peptides, then shows Czon1107 allosterically inhibits human nicotinic receptors.
Studies the CID fragmentation of N-terminal peptide imines as a derivatization that enhances de novo peptide sequencing.
Broad DL-in-proteomics review (de novo is one of several topics)
Prescreens neuropeptide precursors for a conserved family motif before de novo sequencing, so only the variable part of the sequence has to be read.

Microstructural and proteomic study of the European thorny oyster shell matrix. In the absence of genomic data, de novo reconstructed peptides were reported, most of them matching no known shell protein.

Reaches complete monoclonal antibody sequence coverage by pairing the usual LC-MS/MS with capillary electrophoresis, on the argument that one separation chemistry alone leaves gaps no amount of searching can fill.

Identifies cryptic HLA-I peptides by matching the top de novo sequencing candidates for each spectrum against a six-frame translation of the genome and transcriptome, then scoring them in a stratified FDR; showed cryptic peptides are a substantial part of the HLA-I immunopeptidome.
A database-independent metaproteomics pipeline that maps de novo peptide sequences to taxonomy and function, giving quantitative community profiles without a sample-specific database.

Deep-neural-network discrimination of the isomeric residues leucine and isoleucine, which are practically indistinguishable in de novo sequencing from ordinary tandem MS data. Rather than relying on the characteristic satellite ions that EThCD fragmentation produces, it learns from raw spectra directly, searching a broader range of the signal for other evidence that separates the two.

O'Bryon, Jenson & Merkley 2020 Protein Science review arguing that de novo peptide identification is under-appreciated relative to database-search methods, with concrete forensic / non-model / immunopeptidomic cases where it wins.

Palaeoproteomic species identification of Later Stone Age remains from Leopard Cave, Namibia, using de novo derived type I collagen sequences proposed for wild antelopes. The remains thought to be early domestic caprines turned out to be a wild antelope.
A naive triplet-based correlation algorithm for de novo sequencing of conopeptides without transcriptome guidance, tested on a theoretical spectrum.

In vitro proteasomal digests of viral and self polypeptides were analysed with a tailored mass-spectrometry de novo sequencing workflow to define the residue and length signatures of forward and reverse cis-splicing.
Point-set network

Expert Review of Proteomics survey of de novo sequencing at the protein level: how MS/MS-derived peptide sequences are assembled into full protein sequences, the algorithmic and instrumental limits involved, and where the approach beats database search for organisms and proteoforms absent from reference databases.
Identifies the antioxidant peptide VDLPTCKGF in Ganoderma lucidum hydrolysate by de novo sequencing and tests truncated synthetic variants.

Cecal metaproteomics of 5/6 nephrectomy mice fed resistant starch, where PEAKS de novo peptides above 80% ALC were submitted to Unipept to profile the bacterial taxa, alongside database identification.
Favours selective, high-quality fragmentation over sequence coverage to produce sequence ladders through IgG CDR3 regions, so the variable regions can be read de novo.
Bottom-up and top-down peptidomics of male and female Bothrops atrox venoms that identified 105 native peptides, some sequenced de novo, and found higher disintegrin levels in female venoms.
De novo MS Ontology: an ontology for representing de novo sequencing results, including many-to-many mappings between spectra and peptide predictions.

Native-peptide discovery workflow combining suspect-screening for short peptides (2-4 aa, including modified aminoacyl derivatives) with database + de novo sequencing for medium-sized peptides (2,665 identified by de novo alone) from sea bass muscle, generalising to any food-matrix bioactive-peptide search.

De novo sequencing used to establish what the N terminus of a recombinant protein actually is, which the biological argument then rests on. Arabidopsis Rubisco large subunit variants expressed in E. coli are processed unpredictably by the host, so the construct sequence does not tell you which residues survive. Purified proteins were run on SDS gels, the RbcL band excised, and the N termini determined by de novo mass spectrometric sequencing in PEAKS Studio X+, alongside a semi-specific tryptic database search and peak-area quantification; the work was done as a service by the Bioprocessing Technology Institute, A*STAR. The result is Table 1 in full: the observed N termini for wild type and each truncation variant with their peak-area ratios, showing for instance that wild type is a mixture of MSPQTETKAS, SPQTETKAS and PQTETKAS at 36, 15 and 49 percent. Those assignments are what let the paper claim that large subunits lacking residues 1 to 4 are functional carboxylases that Rubisco activase cannot activate, and they drive a further inference about cooperativity, since some deltaN2 N termini proved identical to deltaN3 ones. A tryptic database search alone would not have found them, because host processing leaves ragged non-tryptic N termini.
Studies how sodiated C-terminally amidated peptides fragment under CID and PSD, as a basis for de novo sequencing of small natural peptides.
Gas cluster ion beam SIMS with Orbitrap analysis fragments surface proteins in situ, and de novo peptide sequencing annotates 16 proteins, enabling protein imaging and depth profiling in skin.

Characterises the proline/alanine-specific protease ProAlanase and shows that combining its peptides with tryptic ones gives nearly complete de novo sequencing coverage of the proline-rich Notch3 intracellular domain with PEAKS.
A residual network with an attention mechanism for de novo peptide sequencing.
Distinguishes guanaco, vicuna, llama and alpaca fibres, including archaeological samples, with taxonomic keratin peptides found by database-assisted de novo sequencing and molecular networking.

Direct de novo sequencing of monoclonal IgG from the purified product with a panel of complementary proteases and both stepped HCD and EThcD on every precursor, demonstrated on the anti-FLAG-M2 antibody.
A five-minute LC-MS/MS screen keyed on the 46 Da neutral loss of formic acid to find di- and tripeptides in whey and porcine liver hydrolysates, with de novo sequencing to name them.
Quantifies and images feeding-state neuropeptides in the crab Cancer borealis, with de novo sequencing yielding 69 new putative neuropeptides.
Random peptide library plus MS de novo sequencing (RPLD-MS) defined the peptides bound by swine SLA-I variants, linked to crystal structures of the binding pockets.
Manual de novo sequencing of eleven novel conotoxins from the venom of the vermivorous cone snail Conus inscriptus.

Proteogenomic search for unannotated proteins in Eucalyptus grandis using a dedicated de novo peptide sequencing pipeline (PEAKS plus PatternLab), confirming 41 novel peptide forms, mostly from alternative reading frames, by PRM.
Characterises non-canonical myeloma proteins with an adapted immunofixation electrophoresis, native top-down mass spectrometry and middle-down de novo sequencing.
De novo sequencing of active fractions of a silk cocoon waste hydrolysate identified seven candidate antioxidative peptides.
Establishes the skin peptidome of the Cuban treefrog Osteopilus septentrionalis by manual de novo sequencing, the host defence peptides in amphibian skin glands being their primary immune armament.
De novo sequencing of patient-derived monoclonal immunoglobulin light chains in multiple myeloma by combining bottom-up and top-down proteomics without a database.
Compares male and female blue crab neuropeptidomes by labelled quantitative MS, with de novo sequencing proposing hundreds of putative new neuropeptides.
Sequences of nine multiple myeloma and one AL amyloidosis light chains were solved by de novo mass spectrometry sequencing and used to show all have comparable amyloidogenic potential.
Combines top-down proteomics with de novo sequencing to identify peptides encoded by small open reading frames, 1682 of them mapping to human sORFs never characterised before.
iTRAQ comparison of salt stress in C. reinhardtii and the unsequenced snow alga C. nivalis, where de novo sequencing and homology matching in PEAKS identified the C. nivalis proteins.
De novo structure determination of a linear, disulfide-free peptide from the venom of the scorpion Buthacus leptochelys.
Purification and de novo sequencing of a narrow-spectrum bacteriostatic tripeptide from the fungus Geotrichum candidum OMON-1.
A continuous-digestion device with several non-specific proteases yields overlapping peptides that improve coverage of de novo full-length protein sequencing.

Compares the de novo-assisted PEAKS DB search with MaxQuant, Comet and MS-GF+ on HLA class I immunopeptidomics data and a synthetic peptide library. PEAKS reported substantially more peptides, with a bias towards hydrophobic residues.
RP-HPLC fractionation and LC-MS/MS with PEAKS de novo sequencing identified novel antimicrobial peptides in camel milk fermented with L. plantarum IS10.
An open-source OpenMS pipeline in KNIME that combines X!Tandem and MS-GF+ database search, Novor de novo sequencing and SpectraST library search for label-free quantification of DDA data.
De novo sequencing of the patient-specific M-protein followed by a targeted MS/MS assay tracks multiple myeloma in serum far more sensitively than SPEP or IFE.
Proteogenomic HLA class I immunopeptidomics in melanoma and EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma, using de novo search to find variant, PTM and lncRNA-encoded peptides.
Shows Cathepsins D and L cleave IgGs right after CDR3, producing sequencing-sized fragments for middle-down de novo antibody sequencing.
Combines Ribo-seq-derived sORF databases with database search and de novo sequencing to identify 308 noncanonical MHC class I peptides from two tumor cell lines.

MHC class I immunopeptidomics of Loucy and A375 cells where PEAKS de novo sequencing identified spliced peptides making up about 5 to 7% of the MHC-bound repertoire, validated with synthetic peptides.
MaxQuant spectrum-graph de novo
Personalized assay that de novo sequences each multiple myeloma patient's M-protein, then quantifies its unique peptides by targeted MS to predict relapse earlier than standard tests.
Applies the SMSNet hybrid de novo approach to mono-allelic HLA-I peptidomics data to find new ligands, refine binding motifs and flag likely contaminant peptides in community databases.
Compares Mascot, PEAKS DB and SPIDER homology search for identifying 2-DE spots of the unsequenced greenshell mussel, with de novo strategies adding proteins.
Full-length protein sequencing
A C1q domain-containing lectin from the mussel Modiolus kurilensis whose full sequence was assembled from de novo mass spectrometry peptide sequencing complemented by Edman degradation.

De novo MS workflow (LC-MS coupled with Stitch / native MS) for profiling the circulating human plasma IgG1 antibody repertoire, demonstrating individual-specific dynamics: landmark application of de novo to clinical antibodyomics.

Tells a correct spectrum interpretation from its plausible alternatives by convolving the set of length-k sequence tags a candidate implies, attacking the step de novo sequencing is weakest at: not producing a sequence but choosing between the ones it produced.

Uses PASEF on a timsTOF to accelerate the multi-protease digests (trypsin, elastase, chymotrypsin) that confirm a biopharmaceutical sequence, with data clean enough to drive de novo sequencing as well.
De novo sequencing of the native peptides in an ACE-inhibitory extract of the snakehead fish Channa striata.
Profiles circulating neuropeptides in crab hemolymph over feeding and reports 96 putative new neuropeptide sequences found by de novo sequencing.
Affinity selection from 200-million-member synthetic libraries with de novo MS/MS decoding found ACE2-binding peptides with nanomolar affinity.

Venomics + antivenomics workflow using SDS-PAGE, RP-HPLC and Q-TOF LC-MS/MS with PEAKS + Novor de novo sequencing to identify 115 proteins across 17 venom protein families in Indian cobra venom from the Western Ghats, and benchmark polyvalent-antivenom recognition.
Improved DeepNovo model
De novo peptides from sinking and suspended particles in the eastern tropical North Pacific revealed fungal proteins and tracked modified cyanobacterial peptides with depth.
Identifies vicilin, legumin and antimicrobial peptide 2a as macadamia nut allergens from IgE-binding bands by tandem MS with de novo sequencing.
Characterises low molecular weight peptides in virgin olive oil by Orbitrap MS/MS, with several new peptides sequenced de novo by PEAKS and their bioactivity predicted.

Random peptide library binding plus LC-MS/MS de novo sequencing (RPLD-MS) showed that swine SLA-1*13:01 binds more long peptides than SLA-1*04:01, explained by crystal structures.
Perspective on affinity selection from synthetic peptide libraries of phage-like diversity, made possible because de novo MS/MS sequencing identifies the binders without a library index.
Review of FT-MS in the de novo top-down sequencing of natural nontryptic peptides from cones, bees, snakes, amphibians and scorpions.

Assembles de novo peptides from Casanovo, PEAKS, pNovo and MaxNovo into full antibody sequences, and corrects the two error classes that assembly alone cannot: mass coincidences, where a different residue combination matches the same mass, and I/L ambiguity.
Improved deep learning model
Amino-acid-aware transformer
Evaluation of how de novo sequencing algorithms degrade as spectra lose fragmentation cleavages and gain noise, run over eight published datasets with Novor and DeepNovo.
Microproteins across 11 Drosophila melanogaster developmental time points were identified, 44 of them by de novo sequencing validated with synthetic peptides.
Combined bottom-up proteomics with a transcriptome database and hybrid de novo sequencing to characterize beaked sea snake venom, the de novo step adding 46 toxin peptides.

Metaproteomic analysis of two 30,000-year-old mammoth trunks with PEAKS de novo and SPIDER homology search, characterising collagen I alpha-1 and alpha-2 sequences and three candidate diagnostic amino acid substitutions.
De novo sequencing of peptides and proteins from alligator serum and leukocytes to study reptile innate immunity.
De novo sequencing of HLA class I ligands from a colorectal cancer line found genome-untemplated proteasome-spliced peptides that CD8+ T cells recognise.
De novo peptide sequencing plus taxonomic assignment and statistical scoring to characterize protein sources in complex forensic samples: a precursor to the MARLOWE tool from the same PNNL group.
Proteome of Dactylorhiza tubers inoculated with a Tulasnella fungus, where de novo sequencing plus homology search covered the absence of an orchid genome.

Complete monoclonal-antibody sequencing from multiple enzyme digests read by HCD and EThcD, with the de novo calls made template-assisted in Supernovo. Refined on an antibody of known sequence, then applied to 25 anti-haemagglutinin influenza antibodies of unknown sequence, recovering high-confidence sequence for over 99% of the CDRs; the resulting heavy and light chains were cloned and expressed, and the recombinant antibodies reproduced the original binding curves. Distinguishes Ile from Leu correctly on the known-sequence controls.

Deep-learning (CNN + RNN) de novo peptide sequencer trained on 5 M peptide-spectrum matches from 55 phylogenetically diverse bacteria. Identifies microbial community members directly from metaproteomic MS/MS, then builds sample-specific protein databases without requiring matched metagenomes: validated on native soil microbiome samples.

Active-learning wrapper around Tran et al. 2019's DeepNovo-DIA. Uses acquisition functions to pick the most informative spectra at each training iteration instead of random selection. Benchmark evaluation of de novo peptide sequencing tools for monoclonal antibody assembly.

Multi-omics venomics of Russell's viper (Daboia siamensis, Thai specimens): 10x-linked-read + short-read genome assembly and venom-gland transcriptomics feed a MAKER-annotated CDS database, which is searched with PEAKS Studio (database) plus SMSNet (deep-learning de novo) to identify 1,662 venom proteins including previously unreported hyaluronidase-1, phospholipase B and waprin.

Data-driven PSM rescoring framework that mixes search-engine scores with DL-predicted features (MS2PIP fragment intensities, DeepLC retention times, ion-mobility, etc.); used to boost de novo + database-search identification rates, including downstream of Casanovo / DeepNovo.
Monitors multiple myeloma M-protein retrospectively by mass spectrometry of archived serum protein electrophoresis gels, using de novo sequencing to find each patient's clonotypic peptides.
Non-canonical antigen selection

Reviews the state of identifying wholly unknown proteins by mass spectrometry and demonstrates it on a snake venom serine protease from Bothrops moojeni, where de novo sequence tags such as D[K/Q]D[I/L]VDD[K/Q] made the identification.
A de novo assembler for short peptide sequences that reconstructs protein targets into contigs of 100 residues or more from LC-MS/MS peptide reads.

De novo peptide sequencing tool from the Cindrić group, coupling MALDI-TOF/TOF fragmentation of chemically activated peptides with de novo sequence elucidation and NCBInr alignment for organism identification (bacteria, viruses, meat-species markers).

Culture-independent MALDI-TOF/TOF de novo peptide sequencing workflow (using Protein Acrobat + NCBInr alignment) that identifies uropathogens directly from native patient urine in under 24 h, side-stepping the standard 24–72 h culture step in clinical microbiology.

High-resolution LC-MS with de novo peptide sequencing to identify and confirm mature adipokinetic-hormone (AKH) neuropeptides, including novel sequences with post-translational hydroxyproline, across one cockroach, two moths and two flies, cross-checked against genome/transcriptome predictions.
CNN and LSTM models trained on BLAST homologs predict the missing amino acids in a de novo protein scaffold, tested on alemtuzumab.
Two-protease digestion and de novo-assisted assembly gave full sequence coverage of an aflatoxin B1 monoclonal antibody, with all CDRs correct.
Combines continuous enzymatic digestion, to expose Leu/Ile at peptide N-termini, with a combined verification score over multiple MS3 spectra, resolving 67 of 68 Leu/Ile sites in trastuzumab.
Sequences de novo an antibody that recognises an alternative conformer of cytochrome c, so that conformational states can be detected in cells and tissue, and rebuilds it from that sequence.
Review of mass spectrometric approaches to the de novo sequencing of the nontryptic skin peptides of ranid and hylid frogs.

Characterises the HLA ligandome of two hypermutated colorectal cancers, finding 97 cryptic tumour-specific candidates with the de novo-based Peptide-PRISM, and shows patients' T cells stimulated with them recognise autologous tumour cells.
Venom peptidomes of six myrmicine ants characterised by integrating transcriptomics with PEAKS de novo sequencing of venom peptides, defining 79 myrmicitoxin precursors in 38 families.
Algorithm for peptide de novo sequencing from a group of SILAC-labeled MS/MS spectra.
De novo sequencing of a ginger-protease fish gelatin hydrolysate yielded the DPP-IV inhibitory peptide GPXGPPGPGP.
Longitudinal intact-mass profiling of IgG1 and IgA1 clonal repertoires in severe COVID-19 patients, with dominant clones sequenced de novo by combined top-down, middle-down and bottom-up proteomics.

Perspective on reading antibody sequences at the protein level rather than from B-cell receptor repertoires at the nucleotide level, surveying what mass spectrometry can already do for therapeutic antibodies and what endogenous, polyclonal ones still demand.
Critically evaluates whether synthetic spectra can train machine-learning de novo sequencing models, comparing against models trained on real data.

N-terminal derivatization with 4-formyl-benzenesulfonic acid under charge-reduction conditions, so overlapping positive- and negative-mode spectra pinpoint the b-ion series for de novo sequencing.
DeepNovo-based multienzyme models for improving peptide de novo sequencing generalizability.
De novo sequencing of the skin antimicrobial peptides of the Arkhangelsk population of Rana temporaria, tracking how the secreted peptides vary between populations.
Russian-language review of proteomic and proteogenomic approaches to antibodies, centred on determining variable-region sequences by de novo sequencing, plus PTM evaluation and bioinformatics tools.
